title: Advance transition
statement: Let $c,C,q\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ and $o$ be finite Boolean words, let $h$ assign an integer head position to each of the $c+1$ work tapes, and let $i$ be one of those tapes. One step of the specified unary machine from the configuration with control state $\mathrm{advance}(i)$ leaves the input-head position, work-tape contents, and output word unchanged, moves work-tape head $i$ one cell to the right, leaves the other work-tape head positions unchanged, and enters control state $\mathrm{loop}(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: Function $h$ assigning integer positions to the $c+1$ work-tape heads
